resources.string: Alerts for reminders you have scheduled through iReminder.

Notifications are generated locally by Android, using the most recent reminder data iReminder was able to read from the iCloud Reminders page. Changes made in iCloud on another device are not picked up until you open iReminder or tap Sync now.
Exact timing lets iReminder notify you at the scheduled reminder time instead of a batched time chosen by Android.
Test reminder scheduled for 30 seconds from now. Close the app and wait.
Reminder data cannot be read from the iCloud page yet, so no alarms were changed. Your existing schedule is unchanged.
The iCloud Reminders page has not finished loading yet.
Sync failed: %1$s (%2$s). Your existing reminders were left unchanged.
Reminder notifications turned off. Existing alarms cancelled.
